big_case.notes: Plenary certiorari grant (limited to the Solicitor General's reformulated Section 11(a) misleading-omissions question) arising from Robinhood's 2021 IPO registration statement, with CVSG participation by the United States and SEC and substantial stakes for capital-markets issuers, underwriters, and private securities class actions nationwide following Omnicare and Macquarie, tempered by its technical statutory scope and exclusion of the Item 303 question.

central_claims.claim: The Court grants certiorari limited to Question 1 in the Solicitor General's reformulated wording ('without an additional inquiry to determine whether the omission rendered any affirmative statement misleading') and denies or does not reach Question 2 (Item 303).

central_claims.basis: The staged record ends with the November 13, 2026 certiorari grant (record/snapshots/2026-11-14.json); no merits ruling or opinion exists yet.
central_claims.claim: If granted, the Court on the merits will likely hold under Omnicare and Macquarie that materiality and misleadingness are separate elements under Section 11(a) and vacate the Ninth Circuit's merger of the two inquiries.
